Call of Duty - Black Ops II.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
Call of Duty - Black Ops II.summary: Rooted in near-future fiction, Call of Duty: Black Ops II propels players into a visual landscape in an epic single player campaign highlighted by branching storylines and non-linear missions. The game is a re-imagined multiplayer that introduces players to some of the most cutting-edge weaponry and equipment that 2025 will have to offer, and punctuated with an all-new Zombies experience running in the multiplayer engine.

Resident Evil - Revelations.name: Resident Evil: Revelations
Resident Evil - Revelations.summary: Resident Evil: Revelations is a remaster of the 3DS game with high quality HD visuals, enhanced lighting effects and an immersive sound experience.
